replica_rule: replica r: numpy default_rng(r) bootstrap of the 30 train files (counts in the closed form; theta on the first n_sub distinct drawn files); validation and test fixed
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation
title: Strict additive-multiplicative (A-M) one-stage reference of Liang, Kumar 2014 against A1 / A3 of E046
question: Does the strict A-M form v = (u + T(u) C) exp(-i phi(u)) (phase and off-axis sum from the same u, in parallel) give more than A1 (Kerr, then triplets of the Kerr output) and A3 (Kerr + triplets of x) at the same RM and the same off-axis terms? Which pruning is better at a fixed Kerr: the cross min(|m|,|n|) <= K or the hyperbola |mn| <= K_th (and magnitude)?

model.LK: u = FIR7(x); v = (u + T(u) C) exp(-i phi(u)), phi = sum_j alpha_j |u_{k+j}|^2 (alpha symmetric, N_c taps); C over off-axis merged terms (m <= n, m, n != 0) of the box max(|m|,|n|) <= M (из литературы: Liang, Kumar 2014 eq. 24-32; cross rule: Xiao 2025)
model.controls: T (all T3 terms + FIR7, closed form), K (Kerr alone)
model.fir_note: Liang's stage input h is the signal after the stage dispersion removal (here: after CDC); FIR7 as in E046 for every arch, so the comparison is at the same linear part

coef_ways.varpro: theta (FIR, alpha) by L-BFGS on 4 files with C eliminated by ridge (variable projection, as E046), then C in closed form on 30 files
coef_ways.seq: Kerr alone by L-BFGS, then ridge for C on the rotated features (the 'ridge' way of the task)

rm: repository convention: Kerr 4L + 2 + (N_c+1)/2 + 4, 12 per off-axis term; LK computes (u + T(u) C) first and rotates once, so it costs the same as A1 (no extra product)
axial_imag_check: E044: |Re C|/|C| on the axes median 1.0-1.6 % (experiments/E044_triplet_audit); LK has real alpha by construction

rule_draft.lk_vs_a1: LK beats A1 (or A3) if, at the same (M, N_c, set) and the same or lower RM, mean test difference over 5 replicas > 2 SE AND > 2 std (larger of the two); on the best configuration by validation also on the 3 E023 splits (same sign on all 3)
rule_draft.pruning: cross beats the hyperbola if at equal number of terms (nearest K) the test reduction is higher by > 2 SE and > 2 std; otherwise 'не доказано'
rule_draft.limits: one channel, one polarization, 1 sps, 5 bootstrap replicas of the train files (closed form, not training seeds), one stage only

value_filter.changes_next_step: yes: a signal makes LK the one-stage form in task 4 (DBP-X + off-axis per step)
value_filter.answered_in_literature: structure yes (Liang, Kumar 2014; Xiao 2025), not on our data
value_filter.needed_for_main_claim: yes: novelty is not claimed; the question is which form to use

decision_if_positive: LK replaces A1 as the one-stage reference
decision_if_negative: A1 stays; LK is reported as equivalent
